scripts.predeploy: pnpm --dir ../.. run build:shared && pnpm run build
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && vinext-cloudflare deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.preview: pnpm run build && wrangler preview --config dist/server/wrangler.json

DB.description: Application database. A new D1 database is created on deploy; schema is applied by the deploy script.

ATTACHMENTS.description: Raw inbound message bodies and attachments.

NOTIFICATIONS.description: Live inbox notifications. One Durable Object namespace, created with the Worker.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs dashboard sessions. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

CF_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token used to create sending domains and Email Routing rules. Needs Email Sending and Email Routing edit on this account.

CF_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare account ID. Dashboard → Workers & Pages → Account ID.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Public origin used in unsubscribe links. Change this after you attach a custom domain.

INBOX_WORKER_NAME.description: Worker name Email Routing should deliver to. Must match the Worker name (`emailflare`).
